verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a documented local HTTP API included with the desktop app, a headless CLI/server mode, and a gRPC API (per GitHub), giving AI-native users multiple documented ways to drive the product programmatically. However, the probe found no discoverable OpenAPI spec at the docs domain and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of the API's robustness beyond first-party docs. Missing for 10: independent verification of API completeness/stability, publicly discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec.
